title: 데이터 비교 및 분석
fullText: Perform a comparative analysis of the two provided datasets. Please synthesize the findings into a comprehensive report, ensuring you cross-reference the results to identify underlying correlations. Finally, evaluate the statistical significance of these patterns to determine if they are scalable.
